post.caption:
In 1947 a moth jammed a relay and was taped into the logbook as the first actual case of bug being found. The word already existed; the joke was finding a literal one. The expensive failures are different: Mariner 1 lost to a single wrong character, Ariane 5 destroyed by reused code meeting a larger number than it expected, Therac-25 overdoses caused by two subsystems disagreeing about state. Each part worked. The joins did not.
